scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Establishment of Entrepreneurship for Breed Development of Rural Poultry
other_conditions: Applicant must establish a Parent Farm, Rural Hatchery, or Brooder cum Mother Unit with at least 1,000 parent layers
Applicant must arrange the remaining project cost through bank loans, financial institutions, or self‑financing
The bird used must be a Low Input Technology bird or any sustainable bird for free‑range management
Applicants must have obtained relevant training, have technical experts, or possess sufficient experience in managing the project
Applicants must have a sanctioned loan or a bank guarantee from a scheduled bank along with project appraisal
Applicants must own or lease land where the project will be established
Applicants must have all relevant KYC documents
No subsidy is provided for working capital, personal vehicle, purchase of land, or cost of rent/lease of land
benefits_summary: One‑time 50% capital subsidy up to ₹25 lakh for setting up parent farms, rural hatcheries or mother units, disbursed in two installments via SIDBI.
